runs.text: . An attribute after the dot is a
; a method call is not. The receiver is computed only once.
There is no overloading: two members of a class cannot share a name, even if one is an attribute and the other a method.

blocks.title: An attribute without This
blocks.source:
Clase Contador
  Definir valor Como Entero;
  Metodo Sumar()
    valor <- valor + 1;
  FinMetodo
FinClase

Algoritmo Mal
FinAlgoritmo

runs.text: A method is one more function of the intermediate representation with a hidden first parameter: the receiver.

points.text: A method works on its receiver, the object before the dot.
is required for the object's members.
Methods can be public or private; there is no overloading.
